home.question: What did trials from India report about low-dose metronomic chemotherapy in head and neck cancer?
home.label: From PubMed. Every line is quoted word for word from the paper's abstract. Published evidence, not advice for any patient.

search.used: (metronomic chemotherapy OR low-dose chemotherapy) AND ("head and neck neoplasms" OR "head and neck cancer") AND (India OR Indian)

attempts.term: (metronomic chemotherapy OR low-dose chemotherapy) AND ("head and neck neoplasms" OR "head and neck cancer") AND (India OR Indian)

statements.text: A randomized phase III trial in India found that triple metronomic chemotherapy (TMC) significantly improved survival outcomes compared to physician choice therapy in platinum-refractory head and neck cancer.

citations.quote: These results suggest that TMC significantly improves survival outcomes over physician choice therapy in platinum-refractory head and neck cancer.

statements.text: A randomized phase III superiority study reported that adding low-dose nivolumab to triple metronomic chemotherapy improved 1-year overall survival from 16.3% to 43.4%.

citations.quote: The addition of low-dose nivolumab led to an improvement in the 1-year OS from 16.3% (95% CI, 8.0 to 27.4) to 43.4% (95% CI, 30.8 to 55.3; hazard ratio, 0.545; 95% CI, 0.362 to 0.820; P = .0036).

statements.text: A retrospective analysis of 340 patients found that oral metronomic chemotherapy had promising results in selected cohorts, but dismal results for those who failed within 6 months of previous treatment.

citations.quote: Oral metronomic chemotherapy has promising results when used in a selected cohort of patients but has dismal results in patients who failed within 6 months of previous treatment.

home2.question: What did trials report about induction chemotherapy before chemoradiation in locally advanced cervical cancer?
home2.label: From PubMed. Every line is quoted word for word from the paper's abstract. Published evidence, not advice for any patient.

search.used: ("induction chemotherapy" OR "neoadjuvant chemotherapy") AND ("chemoradiation" OR "chemoradiotherapy") AND ("locally advanced cervical cancer" OR "cervical neoplasia")

attempts.term: ("induction chemotherapy" OR "neoadjuvant chemotherapy") AND ("chemoradiation" OR "chemoradiotherapy") AND ("locally advanced cervical cancer" OR "cervical neoplasia")

statements.text: A phase 3 trial reported that short-course induction chemotherapy followed by chemoradiotherapy significantly improved 5-year progression-free survival (72% vs 64%) and overall survival (80% vs 72%) compared to chemoradiotherapy alone.

citations.quote: After a median follow-up of 67 months, 5-year progression-free survival rates were 72% in the induction chemotherapy with chemoradiotherapy group and 64% in the chemoradiotherapy alone group with a hazard ratio (HR) of 0·65 (95% CI 0·46-0·91, p=0·013). 5-year overall survival rates were 80% in the induction chemotherapy with chemoradiotherapy group and 72% in the chemoradiotherapy alone group, with an HR of 0·60 (95% CI 0·40-0·91, p=0·015).

statements.text: A meta-analysis found that adding induction chemotherapy to chemoradiotherapy significantly improves progression-free survival and overall survival, provided the induction chemotherapy is a platinum doublet with paclitaxel administered within 6 weeks.

citations.quote: In patients with LACC, ICT + CCRT significantly improves PFS and OS compared to CCRT alone, provided that the ICT involves a platinum doublet with paclitaxel and is administered within ≤ 6 weeks.

statements.text: A report on 50 patients receiving weekly cisplatin and paclitaxel followed by chemoradiation showed a 3-year overall survival rate of 83.9% and a 3-year progression-free survival rate of 73.6%.

citations.quote: After a median follow-up of 28 months, the 3-year OS rate was 83.9%, and the 3-year PFS rate was 73.6%.

statements.text: The addition of induction chemotherapy to chemoradiation did not adversely impact quality of life compared to chemoradiation alone.

citations.quote: IC added to CRT does not adversely impact QoL compared to CRT, either during IC, during CRT or later.
